system.description:
OPDQ. CR 2 Strange Check to summon an Abomination (p180), Night Gaunt (p181) or Shoggoth (p181) under your control; it takes its Combat Turn right after yours. At the start of each Combat Round, a CR 2 Strange Check keeps it on this plane. At the end of each Combat Round, Doom rises by the number of rounds it has been present (+1, then +2, and so on).

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.68
